when.set-body: @(new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("message", "The provided token is invalid or has expired."), new JProperty("type", "authentication_error"), new JProperty("code", "invalid_token")))).ToString())

@(new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("message", context.LastError.Reason == "SubscriptionKeyNotFound" ? "missing_subscription_key" : "invalid_subscription_key")))).ToString())

@(new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("message", "Request rate limit exceeded."), new JProperty("type", "rate_limit_error"), new JProperty("code", "rate_limit_exceeded")))).ToString())

@(new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("message", "Request blocked by content safety policy."), new JProperty("type", "invalid_request_error"), new JProperty("code", "content_filtered")))).ToString())

@(new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("message", "Token quota exceeded for this subscription."), new JProperty("type", "rate_limit_error"), new JProperty("code", "token_quota_exceeded")))).ToString())
